results.description: Safety, security key to social media use (4999991)
results.text: Practice OPSEC while online, on the phone, or while spending leisure time in social settings, because the adversary could be watching and listening to every word. The internet is at our fingertips with the widespread use of internet-enabled devices such as smartphones and tablets. Make sure that the medium chosen to communicate is secure. Complacency and apathy toward scams in social engineering, phishing and fake accounts are just some examples that lax security leads to poor security.
